title: When the Portrait Wakes
author: Yara Dunmore
blurb: Juniper Zhou, a twin who came home to bury the wrong sibling, keeps the lights on and the doors counted. Then the village's church bell rings although the bell was melted down in 1911 — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must learn the song's last verse without singing along, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
